run_eval_sam3: run the SAM3 evaluator script with ground truth and prediction folders to compute CGF1, IL_MCC, and PM_F1 metrics
run_main: run the main function to evaluate SAM3 predictions against SAC-Gold ground truth subsets and print metrics
review_main: review the main function that iterates over SAC-Gold subsets and evaluates predictions using CGF1Evaluator
review_saco_gold_gts: review the saco_gold_gts dictionary that maps seven SAC-Gold subset names to their ground truth JSON file lists
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional evaluation metrics or custom subset configurations
